channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: No Loss of Voting Rights for Matuas: Amit Shah’s Message to Bengal BJP
item.description: While addressing a press conference in the city on Tuesday afternoon, the Union Home Minister clearly assured the Matua community that the voting rights of individuals who have submitted applications for citizenship under the Citizenship (Amendment) Act will be preserved.

item.title: ‘They’re Making a Big Mistake’: Trump Issues Fresh Warning to Iran
item.description: The US administration announced sanctions against 10 entities and individuals based in Iran and Venezuela, accusing Tehran of supplying conventional weapons to Caracas and threatening US interests across the Western Hemisphere including US homeland.

item.title: After Stellar 2025 Run, Silver Sees Sharp Correction; Gold Holds Firm
item.description: Precious metals, especially silver, took a breather on the final trading day of the year on Wednesday, after a run‑up to record high followed by aggressive profit‑booking.

item.title: Shabana Azmi and Dia Mirza Share a Heartwarming London Reunion
item.description: Veteran actress Shabana Azmi is spending the last few days of 2025 in London, and she was joined by one of her close friends, Dia Mirza.

item.title: Hyderabad Gears Up for New Year With Week-Long Drunk-Driving Drive
item.description: With just hours left for New Year celebrations, Hyderabad Police Commissioner V. C. Sajjanar has warned tipplers that there will be zero tolerance for drunk driving.

item.title: New Year’s Eve Snowfall Delights Tourists in Kashmir’s Higher Reaches
item.description: All higher reaches of Kashmir received snowfall in the last 12 hours as the minimum temperature rose above the freezing point on Wednesday, everywhere except Gulmarg ski resort.

item.title: Minorities, Journalists Under Attack as Rights Violations Surge in Bangladesh
item.description: A leading human rights organisation in Bangladesh highlighted widespread rights abuses across the country, including mob violence, extrajudicial killings, deaths in custody, minority persecution, killings in political violence, and suppression of press freedom, local media reported on Wednesday.

item.title: PM Modi’s 2025 in frames: From Operation Sindoor to Ram Mandir Dhwajarohan
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's journey through 2025 unfolded as a sweeping narrative of defining moments, blending national security, governance, diplomacy, spirituality and deeply human connections.

item.title: Govt rationalises certain international letter post services from Jan 1
item.description: The Department of Posts has announced to rationalise certain international letter post services, particularly those without or limited tracking features, and to promote more efficient, accountable and customer-friendly alternatives.

item.title: Nick Jonas grooves to this song of wife Priyanka Chopra with the boys
item.description: American singer and actor Nick Jonas has turned into a complete Bollywood buff, and his latest social media post is proof. As has almost become a ritual, Nick was seen grooving on a Bollywood number before his show.
